description: The cases the workbench's visibility rules are held to, on the server (src/haute/_workbench_visibility.py, tests/test_workbench_visibility.py) and in the view (frontend/src/utils/sheetVisibility.ts, sheetVisibility.test.ts) alike (specs/workbench). Each case names a form, replaces the show_when of the sheets, sections and components it lists, and says, for the values typed (rows by table id, cells by column id), which sheets, sections, components and input columns are hidden; a section on a hidden sheet is hidden too, as is a component in a hidden section.

cases.name: nothing typed hides what waits on a value, but not the index or a column also shown elsewhere
a ticked box shows the sheet waiting on it
an unticked box hides as an untouched one does
a chain of boxes shows each sheet in turn
a sheet waiting on a box on a hidden sheet is hidden whatever the box holds
a component hides on a sheet that shows, and its column also on a component that shows stays
a component shows while its conditions hold
a component whose conditions hold is hidden with its sheet
a condition on a column no component has never holds, and that column is never hidden
a column on a hidden Collection and on a Chart that shows is hidden, since a Chart takes nothing typed
a column only a Chart plots is never hidden, even while the Chart is
a condition on a column only a Chart plots never holds, whatever the value
a sheet testing a column only on itself shows while the value passes
a sheet testing a column only on itself hides while the value fails
